claim_ceiling: Dense embedding complementary role fully characterized at maximum available evaluated scale (22yr/144k, 2000-2021). Three complementary modes validated: (1) Citation heritage recovery AUC 0.79-0.85 > 0.75 threshold PASSED; (2) Section cross-lingual Sachverhalt 0.282 > 0.2 and Dispositiv 0.150 > 0.1 PASSED, Erwaegungen 0.094 < 0.1 FAILED; (3) Linear hybrid complement PASS adversarial gates at 19yr+ (w=0.3-0.4) but REMAIN BELOW TF-IDF baseline (JP 0.61-0.67 vs 0.78-0.79). Fundamental two-mode tradeoff confirmed: TF-IDF citation hybrids = PRIMARY product mode (jurist preference, branch clustering); Dense embeddings = COMPLEMENTARY modes (citation heritage, cross-lingual, linear hybrid complement). Full 174k evaluation BLOCKED by missing bger_ corpus 2022-2026, no bge_/bger_ ID mapping, 2022-2023 quality failures. No further same-cycle work justified.
